name: @fradser/pi-subagents
description: Subagent execution layer for Pi packages — child process spawn and lifecycle, the child roster, session routes, environment policy, workspace isolation, Agent Memory, and the intent child tools (`agent_start`, `agent_input`, `agent_stop`, `agent_inspect`, `agent_list`). Temporary delegation by default, explicitly persistent roles and private sessions, with provider-compatible lazy activation.
author: Frad LEE <fradser@gmail.com>
